goals.name: CTXH Quarterly Theme Mgmt — Ensure All Managers Hit QGs
goals.assessment: was green/4/75 -> RED/2/45 at 40.7% of the quarter elapsed (37 of 91 days), Brian's own call. Green requires >=70% of enrolled movers through stage 4 by 10/31. Actual stage-4 completion by branch against a 16% company-wide figure: Houston 40.6% (reconciled 9/15), San Antonio 19%, North Austin 13%, South Austin 13%, Leander 10% - the four non-Houston figures are the 9/7 read and have not been re-pulled. Three of five branches sit BELOW company. Against a 70% bar that is out of reach without intervention, so the color is red regardless of activity - the prior 75% percent-complete reflected the sandbox and enrollment milestones (both closed) and masked the fact that the binding milestone has barely moved. Intervention is live, not pending: updated messaging and rules go out TODAY off last week's BM session to clear the obstacles slowing signatures and speed-to-competency through stage 4, and the 9/4 retraining ruling removed Stages 2 and 3 as requirements so managers stop re-doing sign-offs with tenured movers. Brian is also working the Training Camp view to drive focus onto red team members and lift engagement region-wide. Stage 4 has been opened to everyone. 9/15 update: Brian worked the managers directly on the app and communicated expectations, and the Houston QG reads surfaced a measurement problem that has to be fixed before the number can be trusted - Sergio reported 40.6%, Alex 26% and Joel 26% for the SAME branch metric in the same week. RECONCILED 9/15 (Brian): 40.6% is the right number - Sergio had it, Alex and Joel were both reporting low. So Houston is materially further along than the 9/7 read showed (26% -> 40.6%) and is now roughly 2.5x the company figure. The rock is Red either way with roughly five weeks to the 10/19 bar.

discussion_points: Rippling time cards and clock-ins - asking for escalation, and the contrast is the argument. Anne sent Rippling a documented four-part package on 7/15: (1) clock-ins failing to register with missing hours, (2) false 'still clocked in from last night' messages that block a shift, (3) profile photos attached to the wrong employee, (4) employees not pulling on any iPad. On 9/4 we got a genuinely good answer - on item 3 only: root cause identified (the timeclock saves HEIC instead of JPEG and the timesheet system can't read it), a download-button workaround shipped, an app-side fix for new photos, and a committed date of end of next week. That is exactly the rigor we want. We have received nothing comparable on the three items that actually cost hours. The ask: what other fixes have shipped, and can we get items 1, 2 and 4 escalated to the same standard as the photo fix. Frustration is real and it is coming from movers, managers and ROs over redundantly and constantly correcting time cards - movers are describing it as getting to a breaking point. Action on our side: the 9/4 note requires each branch to update the timeclock app (Settings > Check for updates) or new photos keep saving in the wrong format - pushing that to all five CTXH branches today.
sync_push.win: The BM sync-up session. Getting that format organized, confirmed and run - two mixed-region rooms of five running simultaneously - and the level of engagement we got out of it. Managers called it a keeper.
